name: ship-flow
description: Takes one feature from an idea or an issue to a pull request

implementerModel.title: Model for building tickets
implementerModel.description: The model a ticket is built on, unless the ticket names its own with a Model: line.

strongModel.title: Model for judgment
strongModel.description: The model of the grilling, the spec, the tickets and the final review.

exploreModel.title: Model for exploring
exploreModel.description: The model of reading the codebase.

shortWindowPercent.title: 5-hour quota threshold (%)
shortWindowPercent.description: No ticket starts once the 5-hour quota window is this full: the run pauses and goes on by itself after the reset.

weeklyPercent.title: Weekly quota threshold (%)
weeklyPercent.description: No ticket starts once the weekly quota window is this full: the run stops building.

contextPercent.title: Context budget of a ticket (%)
contextPercent.description: An implementer that has filled this share of a 200,000-token context window is stopped, and its ticket marked too-large.
